Cool charcoal-gray double-breasted tailored suit over a matte black open-collar shirt without tie, dark fitted trousers, polished black leather shoes and restrained steel cuff details. original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a premium otome 2.5D/3D CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET for Elias Arkwright. Preserve all those across panels, detailed hair strands, sculptural skin and fabric. White studio background, neutral soft light, no text, no watermark, no new accessories, no character redesign, no change of age, no stretched neck or deformed facial anatomy. All panels show this SAME adult character. One landscape 3:2 sheet arranged as a clean 3-column by 2-row grid of SIX head-and-shoulder expression studies, front-facing camera identical in every cell. Expressions in reading order: controlled neutral, skeptical scrutiny, faint strategic smile, alert concentration, restrained irritation, firm warning.
